cases.sentence: «Вот правила о ___: сыновья Аарона должны приносить его перед Господом, к жертвеннику.
cases.explain: «хлебном приношении» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “ ‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

cases.sentence: Священник должен взять пригоршню лучшей муки и масла вместе с благовониями, что на ___, и сжечь памятную часть на жертвеннике как благоухание, приятное Господу.
cases.explain: «хлебном приношении» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial portion, to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Есть же его нужно пресным на ___, во дворе шатра собрания.
cases.explain: «святом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

cases.sentence: Я даю им это как их долю в ___ Мне.
cases.explain: «огненных жертвах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

cases.sentence: Подобно жертве за грех и жертве повинности, это — ___.
cases.explain: «великая святыня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as are the sin offering and the trespass offering.

cases.sentence: Всякий потомок Аарона ___ может есть это.
cases.explain: «мужского пола» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’ ”

cases.sentence: Это его ___ в огненных жертвах Господу в грядущих поколениях.
cases.explain: «постоянная доля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’ ”

cases.sentence: Это его постоянная доля в ___ Господу в грядущих поколениях.
cases.explain: «огненных жертвах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’ ”

cases.sentence: Это его постоянная доля в огненных жертвах Господу в ___.
cases.explain: «грядущих поколениях» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’ ”

cases.sentence: — Вот приношение, которое Аарон и его сыновья должны приносить Господу в день, когда они принимают помазание: десятая часть ефы лучшей муки как постоянное ___ — половину утром и половину вечером.
cases.explain: «хлебное приношение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

cases.sentence: Это — ___ Господа, ее следует сжигать целиком.
cases.explain: «постоянная доля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burned to Yahweh.

cases.explain: «хлебное приношение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

cases.sentence: Священник, который приносит эту жертву, будет есть ее в ___, во дворе шатра собрания.
cases.explain: «святом месте» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

cases.sentence: Все, что прикоснется к мясу жертвы, станет свято, а если ее кровь брызнет на одежду, выстирай ее в ___.
cases.explain: «святом месте» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.
